messages:
maria: FYI the edge audit-bridge in us-west-2 started shedding events ~30m ago, seeing correlated latency spikes on thin GPU warmpool.

sre_jen: saw it, graphs show a 3x increase in enqueue latency and a drop in successful audit writes.

opsbot: ALERT: audit-bridge-usw2 quota_exceeded -> entering shedding mode (policy: sample_low) at 2025-11-04T09:54:20Z

maria: exact symptoms: GPU attach latency climbs, onboarding nodes slow, some node joins timed out. suspect backpressure from audit queueing.

platform_lead: can we route audit -> cheaper sink temporarily? or enable sample_low globally? cost vs compliance tradeoff.

anya: we have runbook step: `bridge:degrade-to-sampling` but that requires SOC approval for production retention changes.

maria: quick mitigation I pushed: enabled per-az sampling for audit-bridge-usw2, 10% retention, and disabled verbose debug logs from keystore-proxy.

keystore-bot: ACTION: sampling toggled for audit-bridge-usw2 by maria at 2025-11-04T10:01:12Z

opsbot: INFO: after sampling toggle, enqueue latency dropped ~45s -> ~12s in the 10m window. GPU warmpool attachment success rate improved to 98%.

sre_jen: still seeing some tail latency on 95th percentile. hypothesis: large batches of audit telemetry still being backpressured into NATGW/NAT queue.

maria: attaching a small log snippet from the bridge, truncated: ```
[09:52:13] audit-bridge queue_len=12034 write_err=429 rate_limit_exceeded
[09:52:14] keystore-proxy backpressure=true kv_cache_miss=0.12
[09:53:01] attach-node id=i-0a12... timeout=30s
```

platform_lead: long-term we should add a dedicated control-plane path for audit ingestion (privatelink+directed-shipper) so it doesn't compete with provision traffic. For now, ops: can you request an emergency quota bump with infra-aws?

anya: raising the quota request now, but expect 1-2 hours for approval during work hours. filing with ticket INFRA-1249.

maria: also propose a short-term toleration policy in console: if audit-bridge QoS > 80% and provision queue > 50ms, then throttle audit at source for onboarding routes. low-risk rule.

opsbot: TICKET CREATED: INFRA-1249 (audit-bridge quota bump) -> assigned to infra-aws-team.

platform_lead: agree with console QoS rule. can product sign off on the retention/compliance aspects? leaving a note for security review.

anya: pinging @security for SOC ack. Also documenting cost impact: routing audit to cheaper sink increases egress/ingest but avoids wasted GPU cycles (~$1.2k/hr during the spike).

maria: next steps: 1) keep sampling in place until quota bump or dedicated path, 2) add console QoS rule PR (I'll open), 3) follow up with SOC + infra-aws. anyone object?

sre_jen: no objections. add a short eval to Redwood Optimize to detect these patterns and recommend sampling automatically.

maria: noted. opening PR and runbook updates now. thanks all :thumbsup:
